s: Shello lehakin miyyom tob lachabero ubo y"g seipim: kol "meleket okel nepesh" lo huttera beyom tob ella im ken oseh otah kede lehanot bah beyom tob, abal asur leepot velishchot ulebashshel beyom tob mah sheyyokal bechol. Veim apa veshachat ubishshel o asa shear melakot "okel nepesh" beyom tob letzorek machar, apillu hu shabbat shechal lihyot achar yom tob — hare zeh loqeh min hattora.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasa hammelaka beyom tob samuk lachasheka, beinyan shei epshar kelal lehanot mimmenna beyom tob atzmo, abal im epshar lehanot mimmenna beyom tob atzmo, ap al pi sheeno rotzeh lehanot mimmenna beyom tob veeno oseh otah ella letzorek chol — hare zeh patur min hattora, ap al pi sheen hammelaka tzerika lo kelal beyom tob, shekkebar akal kol seuddato, hoil im hayu mizdammenim lo orechim shello akelu adayin hayyom hayeta melaka zo tzerika lahem vehaya muttar lo laasotah, im ken hare melaka zo niqret "meleket okel nepesh". Veap sheen lo orechim — en issur min hattora laasotah. Umikkol maqom, chakamim asaruha, vehaoseh ken — makkin oto makkat mardut.

Vaapillu dabar sheen bo melaka kelal, kegon lehadiach kelim vekayyotze bazeh — asur laasot ulehakin beyom tob letzorek chol, vaapillu letzorek shabbat shelleacharayv im lo hinniach erube tabshilin, veken letzorek yom tob sheni baggola, vaapillu letzorek yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana shehen qedushsha achat venechshabim keyom echad arok lehachamir, abal lo lehaqel, shehare anu beqiin biqbiut hachodesh, veanu yodeim sheyyom echad hu qodesh min hattora veyom sheni chol gamur min hattora, venimtza mekin miyyom tob lechol. Velaken yesh lizzaher shello lehabi yayin beyom tob rishon letzorek qiddush shel lel yom tob sheni. Veken lo yechappes beseper tora beyom tob rishon mah shetztzarik liqrot beyom tob sheni, o beshabbat sheachar yom tob ap al pi shehinniach erube tabshilin, sheen erub tabshilin mattir ella tiqqun tzorke seuddat shabbat abal lo shear hakanot miyyom tob leshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman shtz"g.

Bishne derakim hittiru chakamim laasot "meleket okel nepesh" beyom tob letzorek hachol im neheneh min miqtzat melaka zo beyom tob atzmo: ha', sheoseh kol hammelaka bebat achat, kegon shemmemalle chabit shel mayim venotenah al haesh veen tzarik lo beyom tob ella qiton echad — hare zeh muttar, kevan debishat asiyyat hammelaka, dehaynu beshaa shennotenah al haesh, hi naaset kullah keachat, veeno mosip melaka letzorek hachol. Umikkol maqom, asur lomar bepeh bishat bishshul hammayim shehammotar yihyeh lechol, ella mebashshel setam. Vaapillu im eno tzarik beyom tob apillu qiton echad shel mayim shemmebashshel beyom tob — muttar lo lehaarim velomar: tzarik ani leqiton echad shel mayim chammin, umuttar lo lebashshel chabit melea mayim kede lehishtammesh beqiton echad shel mayim chammin beyom tob, vehu sheyyeqayyem haaramato veyishtammesh beyom tob beqiton echad shel mayim shemmebashshel.

Hab', shemmiqtzat hammelaka shenneheneh mimmenna beyom tob hi mashbachat umitalla al yede sheerit hammelaka shehi letzorek hachol, ulepikak ap al pi sheen kol hammelaka naaset bebat achat — hare zeh muttar. Ketzad? Muttar lemallot qedera basar ap al pi shebbeyom tob eno tzarik ella chatika achat, veap al pi shelleachar sheheemid haqqedera etzel haesh hosip bah od basar, vaapillu hayeta qedera qetanna veera mimmenna liqdera gedola vehosip bah — hakkol muttar. Veap al pi shehu mosip bimlaka letzorek hachol, mikkol maqom, kevan shehattabshil yoter mishtabbeach umittaqqen kesheyyesh basar harbeh baqqedera — nimtza shemmah shehu letzorek yom tob hu mitalleh al yede mah shehi letzorek hachol, vahare kol hammelaka hi letzorek yom tob. Abal asur lomar bepeh bishat bishshul shehammotar yihyeh letzorek hachol, ella yebashshel bistam.

Abal im eno tzarik kelal liqdera zo beyom tob, sheyyesh lo acherot, veeno mebashshel ella letzorek hachol, o letzorek yom tob sheni, o letzorek shabbat velo hinniach erub tabshilin, ap al pi sherotzeh leekol beyom tob gam miqqedera zo — en haarama zo moelet lo kelum, kevan sheeno okel ella kede lehattir lo habbishshul. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheeno oseh kol hammelaka bebat achat, dehaynu shelleachar shennatan haqqedera etzel haesh hosip bah basar letzorek machar, venimtza shehu mosip bimlaka letzorek machar, ulepikak ap al pi shemmah sheokel miqqedera zo beyom tob atzmo hu mishtabbeach umitalleh al yede tosepet melaka zo — en shebach veilluy zeh moil kelum, kevan shehu beatzmo eno tzarik leshebach veilluy zeh kelal, shehare eno tzarik leekol kelal min qedera zo beyom tob, veeno okel mimmenna ella kede lehattir lo lebashshelah letzorek machar. Abal im hu oseh kol hammelaka bebat achat, dehaynu shemmittechilla natan kol habbasar biqdera veheemidah etzel haesh, venimtza bishat asiyyat hammelaka, dehaynu amidat haqqedera etzel haesh, hi naaset kulla keachat — muttar lehaarim velomar: okal miqqedera zo hayyom. Veap al pi sheeno tzarik kelal laakila zo — ap al pi ken muttar lo lebashshelah bishbil akila zo, lepi shello chilleqa hattora bi"meleket okel nepesh" ben shetztzarik leekol ben sheeno tzarik leekol veokel, vekevan shemmah sheyyokal beyom tob hu mebashshel bebat achat im shear habbasar sheyyokal bechol veeno mosip bishbil hachol — hare zeh hetter gamur. Ubilbad shello yomar bepiv shehu mebashshel shear habbasar letzorek hachol, kevan shehetter zeh hu al yede haarama, shehare beemet eno tzarik kelal leekol miqqedera zo. Abal im eno maarim kelal, ella beemet hu tzarik liqtzat basar shebbiqdera zo — muttar lomar bepeh shehammotar tzarik lo lechol, kevan sheen kan shum chashash issur kelal, shehare hu tzarik limat basar, veoto hamat hu mebashshel bebat achat im shear habbasar, vegam oto hammuat mishtabbeach umitalleh al yede shear habbasar.

Veakshav nahagu haolam lebashshel beyom tob rishon beshacharit letzorek lel yom tob sheni, vetoamin meat mittabshil zeh beyom tob rishon, veen nizharin millomar beperush shemmebashshelin letzorek hallayla, vetzarik lehazhiram al kak. Vegam tzarik lehazhiram, shello yosipu basar biqdera achar shekkebar heemiduha etzel haesh, kevan sheeno okel mimmenna ella meat — nimtza shehu mosip bimlaka bishbil yom tob sheni, velo huttera haarama ella im ken oseh kol hammelaka bebat achat.

Vegam nakon lehazhiram, shello yinhagu ken ella beyom tob rishon letzorek lel yom tob sheni, shehu letzorek mitzvat simchat yom tob, abal lo yebashshelu behaarama zo beyom tob sheni letzorek hachol, lepi sheyyesh machmirin veoserim hahaarama legamre, veen hetter ella im ken beemet hu tzarik limat basar, veaz hittiru lo chakamim al derakim hallalu shebbearnu. Vekol baal nepesh yachush ledibrehem ap beyom tob rishon letzorek lel yom tob sheni.

Veap lisbara harishona en hetter lehaarim ella qodem akilat shacharit, hoil umebashshel beshaa shekkol habbasar hu rauy lo, sheillu haya rotzeh haya okel kol basar hazzeh bisuddat shacharit, abal achar akilat shacharit — en hetter lehaarim. Ella im ken beemet hu tzarik lachatika achat — muttar lo lehosip biqdera kamma chatikot apillu bezeh achar zeh. Veap al pi sheoseh ken letzorek hachol, mikkol maqom, kevan shemmah shelletzorek yom tob mishtabbeach umitalleh al yede ribbuy habbasar — hare hakkol nechshab tzorek yom tob.

Vaapillu qodem akila en hetter lehaarim ella biqdera achat, abal asur lebashshel min echad bishte qederot velitom meat mikkol achat, kevan shettaam shette haqqederot hu shaveh, im ken kol mah shettoem mishtehen yakol litom meachat, venimtza shehaqqedera hashshenit enah mitbashshelet ella letzorek hachol. Abal muttar lebashshel kamma matammim bekamma mine qederot qodem akilat shacharit (beyom tob rishon letzorek lel yom tob sheni), vetoem kezayit mikkol achat veachat, vaapillu matim letinoq day bekak lepi sebara harishona shebbearnu shehi iqqar.

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad shekkebar bishshel beyom tob letzorek hachol apillu achar akilat shacharit, vaapillu bishshel bekamma qederot, im hem mine matammim shonim bekol qedera uqedera — hare zeh toem kezayit mikkol qedera beyom tob, umuttar leoklam bemotzae yom tob miyyad, veeno tzarik lehamtin kelum. Veap al pi shebbishshel beissur — lo qenasuhu chakamim, kevan shettaam mikkol qedera uqedera beyom tob velo haya bishshulo legamre letzorek hachol. Vaapillu lo taam meuma mehaqqederot, ella shebbishat habbishshul haya bedato litom mikkol achat veachat, im bishshel qodem akilat shacharit — muttar leekol mehem bemotzae yom tob miyyad, kevan shebbishshulo haya behetter, shehaya rotzeh leekol mikkol achat veachat.

Abal im bishshel letzorek hachol shette qederot mimmin echad shavin betaman, ap al pi shebbishshel qodem akilat shacharit al semak hetter haarama, dehaynu sheyyokal kezayit mikkol achat veachat, o apillu akal kezayit mikkol achat veachat, o sheheerim lomar: shemma yizdammenu li orechim veetztarek lishte haqqederot, ben sheakel mehen beyom tob ben shello akal — hare maakalim hallalu asur lo ulekol anshe beto leolam, kevan shehora hetter leatzmo lehaarim haarama sheasaruha chakamim — yesh lachush shemma yattir leatzmo paam acheret, vegam acherim yilmedu mimmennu hetter zeh — lekak qenasuhu chakamim. Abal acherim muttarim leekol mehem bemotzae yom tob miyyad.

Vekol zeh bemaarim, shessabur sheoseh kehetter chakamim, abal hambashshel bemezid beyom tob letzorek hachol — hare tabshil zeh muttar bemotzae yom tob miyyad apillu lehambashshel atzmo, dekevan shehu rasha sheasa bemezid — en lachush shemma yilmedu acherim mimmennu laasot kemaasehu bemezid, vegam hu atzmo mesim el libbo veshab, lekak lo qenasuhu chakamim. Vegam al mah shekkebar abar ubishshel beyom tob — lo rau chakamim leqonso al issure yom tob haqqallim, ella al issure shabbat hachamurim hu sheqqanesu, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"ch veshak"g veshal"t. Veken haddin beoseh shear melakot "okel nepesh" letzorek hachol, o letzorek shabbat shelleacharayv velo hinniach erube tabshilin, o letzorek yom tob sheni.
